# Changelog

## 1.6.10-fortran.1

- Initial modern Fortran/FPM translation of the complete exported numerical API.
- Added typed shrinkage results and explicit status codes.
- Added self-contained Jacobi eigen, compact SVD, and pseudoinverse routines.
- Added high-dimensional low-rank correlation-power algorithms.
- Added tests, examples, build scripts, documentation, and upstream provenance.
